name: Evelynn × Unreal Tournament Killstreaks Announcer
creator: dear-agony
description:
### Overview

Alternative version of the original Evelynn announcer mod:

https://runeforge.dev/mods/707366e7-0d1e-4590-b33f-51fd8ff23d92

This version uses the classic Unreal Tournament female announcer ("sexy" announcer) for multikills and killstreaks.

Since the original UT files are quite old, the audio was additionally enhanced to improve depth and overall consistency.

---

### Unreal Tournament killstreak & multikill announcements

*(original League announcements → Unreal Tournament replacements)*

**Multikills**

• First Blood → First Blood!  
• Double Kill → Double Kill!  
• Triple Kill → Multi Kill!  
• Quadra Kill → Monster Kill!  
• Penta Kill → Holy Shit!  

**Killstreaks**

• Killing Spree → Killing Spree!  
• Rampage → Rampage! / Ultra Kill!  
• Dominating → Dominating!  
• Unstoppable → Unstoppable!  
• Godlike → Godlike!  
• Legendary → Wicked Sick! / Ludicrous Kill!

---

### Compatibility

Fully compatible with all game client languages.
